text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic male character. tousled chestnut brown hair, pale blue-green eyes, eyebrow ring and small ear hoop, black crewneck T-shirt. One straight frontal eye-level head-and-shoulder portrait, neutral resting expression, white seamless background and even soft studio lighting. Pure white background, finely detailed natural skin, consistent identity and original hairstyle, no text or watermark.
original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE independent photorealistic identity-reference portrait of the SAME person in the input photograph. Preserve his individual face shape, exact characteristic eyes, eyelids, brows, nose, lips, jaw, complexion, age appearance and natural facial details; do not substitute a generic handsome face or merge identities. Repose him into a rigorously straight-on passport-style photograph. Pure solid white #FFFFFF background. The entire head and both shoulders are square to the camera: yaw 0 degrees, pitch 0 degrees, roll 0 degrees. Camera exactly at pupil height on the face's central axis, never above or below. Both eyes on an exactly horizontal line, nose bridge, philtrum and chin centered on one vertical line. Show equal left/right facial exposure, both cheek contours and ears equally visible where hair permits, neither cheek closer to lens. Shoulders level and equally distant from camera. Chin neither lowered nor raised. Both pupils look directly into lens. Preserve natural anatomical asymmetry without geometric head tilt; do not mirror half of the face. Calm neutral expression, lips gently closed, eyebrows relaxed, no smirk, no seductive pose. Keep recognizable hairstyle, dry natural texture and roughly original hair color (a subtle shade variation is allowed); no strands hiding eyes. Clothing: black crewneck T-shirt, retain small ear and eyebrow piercings. Vertical 3:4 studio ID-photo composition, full hair and crown uncut with small white margin above, crop at upper chest, centered head occupying most of the frame, not a full body image. Symmetrical large soft frontal lights, neutral white balance, even exposure on both sides of face, no directional sunlight or hard cast shadows, preserve realistic skin pores without oily sheen or plastic retouching. Hands, phone, props, original background, all text, logos and watermark removed. This is a plain character reference photograph, no document template, no border, no captions, no collage. Critical acceptance criterion: genuinely fully frontal facial anatomy, no head cant or sideways glance whatsoever.
